name: Allah
overview: The term 'Allah' is often used to refer to God, but Scripture reveals the true nature of God through Jesus Christ, who is the Word and God Himself (John 1:1). Jesus teaches that peace and love, even toward enemies, characterize the children of God (Matthew 5:9, 5:44; Luke 6:28). Furthermore, salvation and access to the Father come exclusively through Jesus, who draws all men to Himself when lifted up (John 12:32) and declares Himself the way, the truth, and the life (John 14:6). This Christ-centered understanding of God contrasts with any view that does not acknowledge Jesus as the divine Son and Savior.
